en: Sepia-toned vintage photograph of a small railway station named Melluži. A steam locomotive with a line of carriages stands by the platform while passengers in early 20th‑century clothing wait or walk along the platform. The station is a wooden building with a covered platform, surrounded by trees and telegraph poles. The station name appears on a sign above the platform, and the handwritten caption "MellužI" is at the bottom of the card.
